description: CreateCertificate's 429 is not rate limiting: the spec documents it as `maximum number of certificates is reached - please contact support to increase it`, and GetQuota says the limit only changes through a service request. As the status-mapped TooManyRequests it is retried as throttling. Typed so a caller sees the quota failure at once; httpError 400 keeps it out of the retryable category, as `AuthenticationLocked` does in secrets_manager_kv.
